Job Description

Job Summary

A member of the Market Strategy leadership team, reporting to the VP, Market Strategy, the Director, Business Intelligence & Go-to-Market is responsible for translating commercial strategy into action and using market, customer, and business data to measure performance, identify opportunities, and continuously optimize plans. The role brings together business intelligence, market analytics, strategic planning, and go-to-market capabilities to drive stronger commercial decision-making and execution. The ultimate objective is to identify and unlock growth opportunities, sharpen commercial priorities and investment, and elevate execution to deliver against Arterra’s long-term plan.

The Director will lead the development of analytics, insights, and tools that enable the business to clearly understand where to play, how to win, and where to invest, while partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and senior leadership to turn strategy into measurable results. This position is based out of our Mississauga head office (hybrid work model / 3 days in office) and reports to the Vice-President of Market Strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Business Performance Management. A key contributor to the monthly business cycle informing management on performance KPIs across category, volume, and market share (brand, geography, segment, pack etc.). Leverage compelling story-telling to clearly articulate performance drivers in a concise manner, with clear calls-to-action / next steps.
Data Transformation: lead the journey in partnership with IT to fully democratize and automate our data set. Finally, support the change management involved by offering training and assist first time users in the adoption journey.
Commercial Planning: Lead the development of the annual commercial planning process for the sales team on a national and regional basis. Act as an ‘entreprise’ ambassador to the commercial teams to help facilitate strategy translation into regional execution.
Go-To-Market: day to day execution of our annual sales plan through price, promotion, NPD launches, and shopper programming performance. Strive for continuous improvement in commercial ROI across the different levers of investment. Lead the monthly market PRs with clear & concise storytelling on key performance drivers.
Leadership: Raising the talent level through continuous development of a team of direct reports and their respective team members. Building strong succession planning and recruitment initiatives. Drive engagement across the team. Act as a senior leader of the market strategy group.

10+ years progressive experience in packaged goods industry specially sales intelligence, FP&A, RGM, GTM functions

Ability to diagnose complex business problems and communicate outputs clearly through compelling visuals and excellent verbal skills.

Demonstrates a high level of follow through and ability to meet multiple deadlines

jobs.title: Director, Customer Operations Vendor Strategy & Execution
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

We're looking for a senior leader to join the Affirm Global Operations team as the Director, Vendor Strategy & Operations
to lead Affirm's global BPO and vendor operations program and serve as a true partner in reinventing how we serve customers at scale across our large global vendor network. This leader owns the customer operations vendor strategy, performance, and outcomes of our global servicing network vendor program — customer experience, compliance, operational excellence, resiliency, and cost-to-serve — across a rapidly growing and complex business. The role will be taking ownership and providing programmatic oversight of the vendor program for operations.

This is a senior leadership role for someone who thinks like an owner, not an administrator. The ideal candidate pairs deep expertise in fintech and financial-services customer operations and vendor programs with genuine fluency in applying AI and human call center culture to reinvent servicing across the vendor network. They are relentlessly customer-centric, dive deep into both the customer and front-line vendor agent experience, and know how to build a winning combination of culture and data-driven operations across vendors and our internal team. This role is scoped to grow: the right leader will expand into broader operational scope as our transformation matures and play a key leadership role in shaping the future of Affirm Operations and customer centric company culture.

You'll lead a team of Vendor Managers and In-Country Vendor Managers, partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders, and shape the future of Affirm's global servicing network.

What You'll Do

Strategy, Governance & Reinvention

Define and execute the long-term strategy for Affirm's global customer operations vendor network, balancing customer experience, operational efficiency, resiliency, compliance, and business continuity across all global vendors.
Reinvent how we resolve customer issues and deliver experience across the vendor network, treating the BPO vendor network as an innovation hub rather than a cost center.
Establish governance frameworks, performance standards, and accountability mechanisms across the global vendor ecosystem.
Lead executive-level vendor governance forums, including Quarterly Business Reviews, strategic planning, and escalation management.
Partner with Financial Partnerships on vendor selection, expansion, remediation, and network design, evaluating capabilities, geographic footprint, and concentration risk to inform future-state decisions.

AI & Operational Innovation

Partner deeply across product, engineering and operations teams to deploy agent and customer facing AI and automation across servicing workflows within the vendor network — agent assist, quality, forecasting, and customer resolution — to reinvent cost-to-serve and elevate vendor agent and customer experience.
Bring an experimentation mindset, using AI in everyday problem-solving to reimagine the vendor operating model and program, not just optimize the current one.

Performance & Operational Excellence

Own overall vendor network performance across servicing functions, including CSAT, SLA, compliance, QA, productivity, and efficiency outcomes.
Build mechanisms for vendor performance management, escalation handling, and vendor accountability, and drive systemic improvements across vendors and functional PODs.
Lead recovery efforts for high-risk or underperforming vendor relationships.
Drive target cost optimization programs across all global vendors.

Analytics & Decision Enablement

Partner with Analytics to define vendor reporting requirements, scorecards, and operational health metrics.
Translate operational trends into actionable recommendations for senior leadership, ensuring decisions are grounded in data and measurable outcomes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Build a global "one team" mentality that treats the vendor network as strategic partners rather than order-takers.
Serve as the primary operational leader for vendor-supported servicing functions, partnering with Product, Engineering, Workforce Management, QA, Training, Risk, and Compliance.
Lead large-scale initiatives — vendor migrations, specialization efforts, operating-model transformations, and regulatory implementations.
Act as the executive escalation point for complex vendor, operational, and customer-experience issues.

People Leadership

Lead and develop a team of Vendor Managers and In-Country Vendor Managers, embodying a customer-centric culture and Affirm's values by example.
Establish role clarity, operating rhythms, and performance expectations across the organization.
Coach leaders to strengthen analytical rigor, strategic thinking, vendor-management capability, and cross-functional influence.
Build a high-performing organization anchored in accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.

What We Look For

15+ years in customer operations — including large-scale global vendor BPO program management, operations strategy, or consulting for fast-paced, multi-million-customer businesses using vendor networks (or demonstrated equivalent leadership trajectory).
10+ years leading managers and/or complex global operational and vendor organizations.
Proven success managing large-scale outsourced operations and global vendor networks across multiple international geographies.
Experience leading and optimizing supply and demand management with global work force management teams.
Demonstrated experience deploying AI or automation to improve customer operations or BPO environments at scale.
Strong analytical background, using data to drive strategic decisions and operational outcomes.
Track record leading large cross-functional initiatives with measurable business impact.
Deep cultural fluency across global geographies — a proven ability to lead and motivate diverse international teams and to build a customer-centric, high-performing culture across varied call-center and BPO environments.
Exceptional communication, executive presence, and stakeholder management.

Preferred Qualifications

Industry background in fintech, technology, or financial services, or other high-growth operational environments.
Knowledge of consumer facing compliance-heavy functions such as Fraud, Payments, Compliance, or Financial Operations.
Experience building operating models, governance frameworks, and scalable service-delivery organizations.
Experience designing vendor network strategies that balance performance, resiliency, scalability, and risk.
Leading in fast paced rapid growth environments.

Equity Grade - 7

jobs.description:
Job Description

On behalf of our public-sector client, Affinity is seeking a Chief Courts Information Officer to be accountable for the strategic leadership, governance, and delivery of information management (IM), information technology (IT), and digital services for the Courts. The CCIO ensures that court information systems, digital services, and technology investments support judicial independence, court administration, access to justice, operational efficiency, privacy, and security.

Responsibilities

Develop and implement information management strategies and polices to ensure the secure and efficient handling of Court information.
Project management, change management and strategic planning processes for the effective delivery and management of both short and long-term information technology goals set by the judiciary.
Represent the interests of the judiciary recognizing judicial independence in their day-today operations of and/or projects involving implementing and/or updating software, databases and digital tools used by the judiciary or involving judicial data and court information.
Must operate with full confidence of the Chief Justices and the Chief Judge, be discreet as required and understand the highly confidential and sensitive nature of the work that they perform.
The Chief Court Information Officer (“CCIO”) must have the ability to work cooperatively and harmoniously with all members of the judiciary and both senior and front-line court administration staff, as we as internal and external stakeholders.
Lead the modernization of court information systems, including case management, e-filing, digital evidence, and courtroom technology.

Qualifications

Education and/or training involving computer science, information technology, cyber security or related field.
Significant work experience, preferably 5 years or more, in information technology and information governance, with a focus on cybersecurity and records retention.
Strong understanding of legal and regulatory requirements related to information management, cybersecurity, and records retention.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to develop and implement effective information management strategies for an increasingly digital legal work environment.
Extensive experience conducting IT and information security research and providing advice and opinions, preferably at a senior executive level.
Demonstrated ability to prepare written opinions, memoranda and reports.
The incumbent must have a superior understanding of the principles of judicial independence and possess strong political acumen and experience in the application of discretion and diplomacy to ensure positive outcomes and confidence in the administration of justice.
Well-developed planning and organizational skills in order to accomplish the position’s responsibilities and meet target dates and set priorities.
Experience using MS Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio and Outlook and online legal research databases which may be used by the judiciary. Familiarity with JUDICLOUD (federally appointed judges email network) and/or PowerBI is considered an asset.
Stakeholder engagement - Build effective relationships with the judiciary, court administrators, justice partners, central government IT organizations, and external stakeholders.
Represent the Courts on inter jurisdictional, justice sector, and government technology forums, as required.
Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
On-site attendance is a mandatory requirement for this role.
Must be able to provide a satisfactory criminal record check and security clearance.
The Resource will be required to execute a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) and maintain strict confidentiality with respect to all information obtained or accessed in the course of performing the Services.
Relevant certifications such as the Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
A law degree from an accredited university or college recognized in Manitoba.

jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It's built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet's largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

We are seeking a senior leader to lead Revenue Strategy & Operations for Reddit's Global Large Customer Sales (LCS) channel. This role will serve as the operating partner to the global LCS leadership team, helping translate company and channel strategy into clear goals, disciplined execution, and measurable revenue outcomes across regions, verticals, and customer segments.

You will own the strategy and operations that drive LCS growth—from annual and quarterly planning through weekly performance management, forecasting, resource allocation, and execution of the highest-impact growth initiatives. You will partner closely with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Product, Business Operations, and other cross-functional leaders to improve sales productivity, unlock new pockets of demand, and scale a globally consistent go-to-market model.

This is one role that will lead Strategy & Operations for the Global Large Customer Sales channel. The role is required to be based within commuting distance (50mi) of one of our North America sales hubs in San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago, New York, or Toronto.

Responsibilities:

Serve as a trusted strategic partner to the Global LCS leadership team, shaping channel strategy, priorities, operating model, and investment decisions.
Lead the annual and quarterly planning processes for Global LCS, partnering with Finance as well as regional and vertical sales leaders to build credible goals, capacity plans, coverage models, and resource recommendations.
Establish and run the global business rhythm, including weekly revenue and pipeline reviews, monthly and quarterly business reviews, executive reporting, and mechanisms that turn performance signals into action.
Build a single, trusted view of LCS performance across regions, verticals, customer segments, pipeline, revenue, forecast, productivity, retention, and product adoption; improve the quality and speed of decision-making through clear operating information.
Own the LCS forecasting process and drive continuous improvement in forecast accuracy, inspection, risk identification, and accountability.
Use first- and third-party market, customer, and competitive data to size opportunities, identify whitespace, prioritize segments, and develop programs that expand Reddit's share of large customer advertising budgets.
Partner with regional and vertical sales leaders to refine and scale a globally coherent go-to-market strategy while adapting execution to local market dynamics, customer needs, and commercial maturity.
Develop repeatable playbooks and operating mechanisms that help LCS teams launch, ramp, and scale new sales programs, products, and routes to market with measurable outcomes.
Identify and lead strategic initiatives that improve sales productivity and commercial execution, such as increasing customer-facing time, strengthening pipeline generation, improving deal progression, accelerating product adoption, and reducing operational friction.
Build strong partnerships across Finance, Marketing, Product, Product Marketing, Data Science, Business Operations, and other teams to remove revenue blockers and align cross-functional execution to LCS priorities.
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing global organization of strategists, operators, and analysts, including people managers; create a culture of analytical rigor, accountability, collaboration, and high-quality execution.

Qualifications:

15+ years of progressive experience across sales strategy, revenue operations, business operations, management consulting, investment banking, corporate strategy, or related functions; experience in digital advertising, ad tech, media, or a scaled technology platform is required.
Experience managing multi-tiered teams, including people managers, and building organizations that operate effectively at global scale.
Significant experience leading strategy and operations for a complex, multi-region sales organization, ideally with exposure to large enterprise or strategic customer segments.
Deep understanding of digital advertising, media, platform monetization, and marketplace dynamics; experience with large customer sales, agency ecosystems, and/or global go-to-market models is required.
Strong business judgment and analytical problem-solving skills. You can move from an ambiguous question to a clear framework, an executive recommendation, and disciplined follow-through.
Demonstrated ability to build operating cadences, planning processes, forecasting systems, dashboards, and performance mechanisms that improve business outcomes.
Proven ability to influence senior executives and align stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Marketing, Product, and other functions without relying on formal authority.
Structured systems thinker who balances strategic vision with operational detail and can move fluidly between market opportunity, organizational design, data, and execution.
Strong technical and analytical fluency, including experience with CRM, sales planning, business intelligence, and data systems; comfortable partnering with data, finance, and engineering teams to improve reporting and automation.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex ideas clear and compelling for executives, sales leaders, and frontline teams.

Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing global organization of strategists, operators, and analysts, including people managers; create a culture of analytical rigor, accountability, collaboration, and high-quality execution.

Significant experience leading strategy and operations for a complex, multi-region sales organization, ideally with exposure to large enterprise or strategic customer segments.

Structured systems thinker who balances strategic vision with operational detail and can move fluidly between market opportunity, organizational design, data, and execution.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex ideas clear and compelling for executives, sales leaders, and frontline teams.

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

We're looking for a senior leader to join the Affirm Global Operations team as the Director, Vendor Strategy & Operations
to lead Affirm's global BPO and vendor operations program and serve as a true partner in reinventing how we serve customers at scale across our large global vendor network. This leader owns the customer operations vendor strategy, performance, and outcomes of our global servicing network vendor program — customer experience, compliance, operational excellence, resiliency, and cost-to-serve — across a rapidly growing and complex business. The role will be taking ownership and providing programmatic oversight of the vendor program for operations.

This is a senior leadership role for someone who thinks like an owner, not an administrator. The ideal candidate pairs deep expertise in fintech and financial-services customer operations and vendor programs with genuine fluency in applying AI and human call center culture to reinvent servicing across the vendor network. They are relentlessly customer-centric, dive deep into both the customer and front-line vendor agent experience, and know how to build a winning combination of culture and data-driven operations across vendors and our internal team. This role is scoped to grow: the right leader will expand into broader operational scope as our transformation matures and play a key leadership role in shaping the future of Affirm Operations and customer centric company culture.

You'll lead a team of Vendor Managers and In-Country Vendor Managers, partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders, and shape the future of Affirm's global servicing network.

What You'll Do

Strategy, Governance & Reinvention

Define and execute the long-term strategy for Affirm's global customer operations vendor network, balancing customer experience, operational efficiency, resiliency, compliance, and business continuity across all global vendors.
Reinvent how we resolve customer issues and deliver experience across the vendor network, treating the BPO vendor network as an innovation hub rather than a cost center.
Establish governance frameworks, performance standards, and accountability mechanisms across the global vendor ecosystem.
Lead executive-level vendor governance forums, including Quarterly Business Reviews, strategic planning, and escalation management.
Partner with Financial Partnerships on vendor selection, expansion, remediation, and network design, evaluating capabilities, geographic footprint, and concentration risk to inform future-state decisions.

AI & Operational Innovation

Partner deeply across product, engineering and operations teams to deploy agent and customer facing AI and automation across servicing workflows within the vendor network — agent assist, quality, forecasting, and customer resolution — to reinvent cost-to-serve and elevate vendor agent and customer experience.
Bring an experimentation mindset, using AI in everyday problem-solving to reimagine the vendor operating model and program, not just optimize the current one.

Performance & Operational Excellence

Own overall vendor network performance across servicing functions, including CSAT, SLA, compliance, QA, productivity, and efficiency outcomes.
Build mechanisms for vendor performance management, escalation handling, and vendor accountability, and drive systemic improvements across vendors and functional PODs.
Lead recovery efforts for high-risk or underperforming vendor relationships.
Drive target cost optimization programs across all global vendors.

Analytics & Decision Enablement

Partner with Analytics to define vendor reporting requirements, scorecards, and operational health metrics.
Translate operational trends into actionable recommendations for senior leadership, ensuring decisions are grounded in data and measurable outcomes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Build a global "one team" mentality that treats the vendor network as strategic partners rather than order-takers.
Serve as the primary operational leader for vendor-supported servicing functions, partnering with Product, Engineering, Workforce Management, QA, Training, Risk, and Compliance.
Lead large-scale initiatives — vendor migrations, specialization efforts, operating-model transformations, and regulatory implementations.
Act as the executive escalation point for complex vendor, operational, and customer-experience issues.

People Leadership

Lead and develop a team of Vendor Managers and In-Country Vendor Managers, embodying a customer-centric culture and Affirm's values by example.
Establish role clarity, operating rhythms, and performance expectations across the organization.
Coach leaders to strengthen analytical rigor, strategic thinking, vendor-management capability, and cross-functional influence.
Build a high-performing organization anchored in accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.

What We Look For

15+ years in customer operations — including large-scale global vendor BPO program management, operations strategy, or consulting for fast-paced, multi-million-customer businesses using vendor networks (or demonstrated equivalent leadership trajectory).
10+ years leading managers and/or complex global operational and vendor organizations.
Proven success managing large-scale outsourced operations and global vendor networks across multiple international geographies.
Experience leading and optimizing supply and demand management with global work force management teams.
Demonstrated experience deploying AI or automation to improve customer operations or BPO environments at scale.
Strong analytical background, using data to drive strategic decisions and operational outcomes.
Track record leading large cross-functional initiatives with measurable business impact.
Deep cultural fluency across global geographies — a proven ability to lead and motivate diverse international teams and to build a customer-centric, high-performing culture across varied call-center and BPO environments.
Exceptional communication, executive presence, and stakeholder management.

Preferred Qualifications

Industry background in fintech, technology, or financial services, or other high-growth operational environments.
Knowledge of consumer facing compliance-heavy functions such as Fraud, Payments, Compliance, or Financial Operations.
Experience building operating models, governance frameworks, and scalable service-delivery organizations.
Experience designing vendor network strategies that balance performance, resiliency, scalability, and risk.
Leading in fast paced rapid growth environments.
